title: usage.report frame
description: Task-level usage summary reported by the plugin when a task ends. One report per task, containing one entry per model invocation made during the task. Decoupled from task status: accepted regardless of whether the task completed or failed. Purely observational - no billing or pricing logic.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this usage belongs to.

instance_id.description: Optional plugin instance that produced the calls; defaults to the registered sender.

calls.description: Per-model invocation details for the task.

source.description: Model source label, e.g. official, relay-station-A. No built-in pricing dictionary; the label is stored as-is.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds.

tokens_per_s.description: Generation speed in tokens per second.

duration_ms.description: Total invocation wall time in milliseconds.
